## 2. 💻 Hardware & Equipment Placed in Service (IRC § 179)

*Equipment purchased and placed into active service during the 2026 tax year.*

- **2026 Federal Statutory Section 179 Limit**: **,560,000** (phase-out begins at .2M+).
- **Fleet Hardware Placed in Service**:
  - **Phoebus**: Mac Mini M4 / Pro (Fleet Orchestrator, memory cluster host).
  - **WhoArt**: Asus ProArt PX13 (Windows node, GPU inference, CAD/visuals).
  - **Blade**: Blade1TB gaming/compute node (Ollama Tier 0 inference, local models).
- **Compliance Rules**:
  - Property must be used **more than 50% for business**. If mixed personal/business, deduction is pro-rated to the verified business-use percentage (e.g. 90% business = 90% cost basis).
  - **Taxable Income Limitation**: Section 179 cannot create a net business loss; unused amounts carry forward indefinitely.
  - **Required Documentation**: Invoice/receipt showing date of purchase, vendor, serial number, date placed in service, and written log of business usage percentage.

---

## 3. 🏠 Business Facility & Home Office (IRC § 280A)

*Deductions for workspace within a personal residence.*

- **The Strict Statutory Test**: Must be used **regularly and exclusively** as the principal place of business, or as a place to meet clients/customers in the normal course of business.
- **Methods**:
  - **Simplified Method**:  per square foot (maximum 300 sq ft = ,500 maximum deduction).
  - **Actual Expense Method**: Pro-rata percentage of home expenses (rent, mortgage interest, utilities, homeowners/renters insurance) based on dedicated square footage versus total residence square footage.
- **Audit Flag**: Any space with dual usage (e.g. bedroom, living room, family recreation) fails the exclusive-use test under audit. Space must be dedicated solely to Who Visions / NouGen operations.

---

## 4. 🌐 Internet & Communications (IRC § 162)

- **Dedicated Business Line**: 100% deductible if in the business entity's name and dedicated exclusively to servers/nodes.
- **Shared Residential Internet**: When fleet nodes (Phoebus, WhoArt, Blade) run 24/7 on residential broadband, the business portion must be allocated based on bandwidth/device count/documented uptime logs. (Typically 50% to 80% defensible allocation with logged fleet traffic).

---

## 5. 🚀 Startup Costs vs. Ongoing Operating Expenses (IRC § 195)

- **Pre-Operating / Research Phase**: Costs incurred before the active trade or business begins are startup expenditures (§ 195).
  - Up to ,000 deductible in the first year (subject to phase-out starting at ,000).
  - Remaining balance amortized over 180 months (15 years).
- **Ongoing Operations**: Once Who Visions is an active trade or business generating revenue or offering services to clients, ongoing R&D and operational costs are currently deductible under § 162.

## 6. 💼 Qualified Business Income (QBI / IRC § 199A) & 2026 Updates

- **Entity Pass-Through**: Appears on Schedule C (sole proprietorship/single-member LLC) or Form 1065/1120-S pass-through to personal Form 1040.
- **2026 Rule**: Minimum ** QBID** applies for an active trade or business with at least **,000 aggregate qualified business income**.
- **Specified Service Trade or Business (SSTB)**: If classified under consulting or technical services, income thresholds phase out above standard limits for single/married filers. Consult CPA on entity classification.
